name: Between
source:
A story-driven visual novel set on a quiet coastal town, where fleeting connections, unspoken desires, and personal choices shape how every relationship unfolds.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4340940/Between/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部设定在宁静海滨小镇的剧情驱动型视觉小说——短暂的交集、未言的渴望与每一次个人抉择，都将塑造每一段关系的最终走向。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4340940/Between/]Steam[/url]]
